text:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated 502/504s detected at ingress (eu-west-1). Error rate 18% over 3m, P50 latency ~2x baseline. Paging eng-oncall and eng-sre. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/ingress-5xx

maria (eng-oncall): oncall here, joining. linking logs and starting triage

ben (eng-sre): looking now — any deploys in last 10m?

maria (eng-oncall): no deploys from infra or platform in last 30m. Control plane shows spike in connection resets and some 504 backend timeouts. tailing proxy logs:
```
2026-03-15T01:04:12Z ingress-proxy[abcd] 502 upstream reset id=0x45
2026-03-15T01:04:13Z ingress-proxy[abcd] 504 backend timeout route=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T01:04:14Z ingress-proxy[abcd] 502 connection refused host=10.0.7.12
```

carla (api-platform): I see sticky-session imbalance on hostpool-7, health checks flapping for 10.0.7.12 and a couple of neighbors. looks like one bad node getting most of the traffic due to affinity tokens.

maria (eng-oncall): routing table shows hostpool-7 is pinned for session affinity; retry budget increased earlier today which might have amplified concurrency to the bad node.

ben (eng-sre): propose failing out hostpool-7 temporarily. can someone drain it? command: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/hostpools/7/drain` — i'll prep rollback plan.

david (infra): doing drain now. running: `opsctl pool set hostpool-7 --weight 0 --drain` — will report when started.

ops-bot: hostpool-7 weight set to 0, draining connections (operation id: op_707777_drain)

carla (api-platform): health checks still flapping but requests routed off 10.0.7.12 now. seeing residual 504s — suspect KV cache saturation + long tail GC on that node. recommend reducing ingress concurrency and adding circuit-breaker profile.

maria (eng-oncall): enabling temporary circuit-breaker profile for ingress route /v1/* to tripping=100rps, max_conns=50. applying via feature flag.

ben (eng-sre): applied CB and feature flag, diff below:
```
- ingress.circuit_breakers.v1: { tripping: 500rps }
+ ingress.circuit_breakers.v1: { tripping: 100rps, max_conns: 50 }
```

maria (eng-oncall): monitoring metrics — error rate dropped to ~6% in last 30s after drain + CB :thumbsup:

eve (pm): any visible customer impact? which tenants are hit so we can notify CS?

carla (api-platform): top impacted tenants by error count: acme-inc, beta-xyz, testharness-12. sending quick heads-up to CS and advisory to their CSMs.

maria (eng-oncall): opening incident channel #incident-7077770000 for postmortem notes and customer comms; assigning Ben as incident lead and Carla as platform owner.

ben (eng-sre): taking incident lead for RCA. immediate mitigation summary: drained hostpool-7, applied circuit-breaker, lowered retry budget. next: capture heap/cpu/traces from drained nodes and check affinity token distribution.

david (infra): scaling ingress pool +2 instances as safety buffer: `autoscale up --pool ingress --count 2` — completed.

maria (eng-oncall): do not rollback CB or re-enable that hostpool until metrics stable for 10m. adding initial checklist: 
- confirm error rate <1% sustained for 10m
- validate no customer duplicates/retries
- collect logs/traces from drained nodes (10.0.7.12, 10.0.7.13)
- schedule postmortem in 2 days

ops-bot: Incident commander tagged: ben (lead), oncall: maria, responders: carla,david. Severity: Sev2. Incident channel created: #incident-7077770000

ben (eng-sre): capturing request traces and proxy logs. preliminary timeline looks like affinity + retry budget bump caused concentration then backend GC spike. will post full timeline and RCA notes into #incident-7077770000.

maria (eng-oncall): thanks team — monitoring in steady state now. will wait for 10m stable window then start controlled rollback verification. ping if any regression. :eyes:
